title: Mixture of LLP and EM for a visual matrix speller (ERP) dataset from
description: EEG recordings from an online study with twelve healthy participants using a visual matrix speller (P300 event-related potential paradigm) to compare unsupervised decoding methods. The methods were learning from label proportions (LLP), expectation-maximization (EM), and their combination (MIX). Participants copy-spelled a German sentence in three blocks, one per algorithm, without a calibration recording. The dataset supports research on unsupervised learning for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: 31-channel EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a BrainAmp DC amplifier and Ag/AgCl electrodes in an extended 10-20 montage, with a nose reference. Participants spelled 35 characters in three blocks on a modified 6x6 matrix speller extended with 10 '#' blanks. Two interleaved highlighting sequences were used, with 250 ms SOA and 100 ms stimulus duration.
